abstract: Cost-effective strategies for the follow-up of patients with germ cell tumors must be based on the known natural history of the disease, the accuracy and cost of diagnostic modalities, and the efficacy and effectiveness of therapy when recurrences are detected. The natural history of stage I and stage II germ cell tumors are reviewed, including the unique circumstances of late recurrences. The accuracy and cost of imaging modalities are also reviewed and general recommendations to cost-effective follow-up are proposed.
abstract_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者のフォローアップにおける費用対効果の高い戦略は、疾患の自然経過、診断モダリティの精度と費用、そして再発が検出された際の治療の有効性と有用性に基づく必要があります。病期Iおよび病期IIの胚細胞腫瘍の自然経過を、特に晩期再発という特有の状況を含めて概説します。画像診断モダリティの精度と費用についても概説し、費用対効果の高いフォローアップに関する一般的な推奨を提案します。
